post.summary:
FetchReportData generates and retrieves data for a specific report.
Supports pagination, filtering by business units, and custom grouping
options. Data is returned in a structured format defined by the report's
field configuration.
post.description:
Possible errors:
- INVALID_ARGUMENT if request parameters are invalid
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights
- NOT_FOUND if the report definition doesn't exist

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
FetchReportDataRequest encapsulates parameters for generating report data.
Supports pagination, business unit filtering, and custom data grouping.

post.summary:
ListReports retrieves all available report definitions for a company.
Returns a list of report configurations that can be used to generate
specific data views.
post.description:
Possible errors:
- INVALID_ARGUMENT if company_id is invalid
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ListReportsRequest represents a request to retrieve available reports.

id.title:
Identifier of the report definition to use
Must reference an existing report configuration

queryPeriod.title:
Time period for data collection
Defines the date range for included data

groupByFieldKeys.title:
Fields to group data by
Optional. If provided, results will be aggregated by these fields

FetchReportDataRequestCondition.description:
Condition specifies the report configuration and filtering criteria.
Controls what data is included and how it's organized.

startTime.description:
Optional. Inclusive start of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be the same
or after the start.

endTime.description:
Optional. Exclusive end of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be before the
end.

typeInterval.description:
Represents a time interval, encoded as a Timestamp start (inclusive) and a
Timestamp end (exclusive).

The start must be less than or equal to the end.
When the start equals the end, the interval is empty (matches no time).
When both start and end are unspecified, the interval matches any time.

currencyCode.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

units.description:
The whole units of the amount.
For example if `currencyCode` is `"USD"`, then 1 unit is one US dollar.

nanos.description:
Number of nano (10^-9) units of the amount.
The value must be between -999,999,999 and +999,999,999 inclusive.
If `units` is positive, `nanos` must be positive or zero.
If `units` is zero, `nanos` can be positive, zero, or negative.
If `units` is negative, `nanos` must be negative or zero.
For example $-1.75 is represented as `units`=-1 and `nanos`=-750,000,000.

typeMoney.description: Represents an amount of money with its currency type.

fieldKey.title:
Reference to the field definition
Must match a field key in the table structure

fieldType.title:
Data type of the value
Must match the field definition

value.title:
Actual value of the cell
Type must match field_type

v1Data.description:
Data represents a single cell value in a report table.
Includes both the field metadata and the actual value.

pagination.title:
Pagination parameters for handling large result sets
Required to manage data volume efficiently

companyId.title:
Company identifier for data access control
Required to ensure data is scoped to proper context

businessIds.title:
List of business units to include in the report
If null, all business units are included in the report

condition.title:
Report configuration and filtering parameters
Controls the structure and content of the results

v1FetchReportDataRequest.description:
FetchReportDataRequest encapsulates parameters for generating report data.
Supports pagination, business unit filtering, and custom data grouping.

nextPageToken.title:
Token for retrieving the next page of results
Empty if there are no more results

tableData.title:
Structured report data including fields and rows
Contains the actual report content

v1FetchReportDataResponse.description: FetchReportDataResponse contains the generated report data.

label.title:
Display label for the field
Used in report headers and UI elements

type.title:
Data type of the field
Determines value formatting and validation

key.title:
Unique identifier for the field within the report
Used to reference field values in data structures

groupByEnable.title:
Whether this field can be used as a grouping criterion
Affects report aggregation options

v1Field.description:
Field defines a single data column in a report.
Each field has a specific data type and display properties.
Fields can be used for grouping data and determining how values are formatted.

v1FieldType.description:
Type specifies the data type and formatting rules for a field.
This determines how values are stored, displayed, and processed.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default value when type is not specified
Should not be used when creating new fields
 - MONEY: Represents monetary values with currency information
Uses google.type.Money for storage
 - TEXT: Represents text or string values
Used for names, descriptions, and other textual data
 - DATE: Represents date values without time
Stored as Timestamp with time set to midnight
 - TIME: Represents time values without date
Stored as Timestamp with date set to epoch
 - NUMBER: Represents whole numbers
Used for counts and integer quantities
 - DECIMAL_NUMBER: Represents numbers with decimal points
Used for precise numerical values
 - PERCENTAGE: Represents percentage values
Stored as decimal (e.g., 0.75 for 75%)
 - DURATION: Represents time duration in minutes
Used for service times and intervals
 - DATETIME: Represents full date and time values
Used for exact temporal data points

companyId.title:
Company identifier for scoping available reports
Required to ensure reports are accessed within proper context

v1ListReportsRequest.description: ListReportsRequest represents a request to retrieve available reports.

reports.title:
List of report definitions available to the company
May be empty if no reports are configured

v1ListReportsResponse.description: ListReportsResponse contains the list of available reports.

pageSize.title:
integer, Number of items to return per page.
Minimum: 1, Maximum: 500

pageToken.description:
string, Token for retrieving the next page.
Obtained from the previous page's response.
Leave empty for the first page.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.

id.title:
Unique identifier for the report
Format: "rpt_" followed by random characters

name.title:
Display name of the report
Used in UI and exported documents

description.title:
Detailed description of the report's purpose and contents
Helps users understand what data is included

fields.title:
List of fields included in the report
Defines the structure and data types of the report

v1Report.description:
Report represents a customizable business report definition.
Reports are used to generate structured data views with configurable fields
and formatting options. Each report can be used to analyze different aspects
of business operations.

rows.title:
Individual data rows in the table
Each row contains values for all defined fields

fields.title:
Field definitions for the table
Can be from TableMeta or dynamically generated

v1TableData.description:
TableData represents a complete data set for a report.
Contains both the structure (fields) and content (rows) of the report.

data.title:
Map of field values indexed by field key
Each entry corresponds to a column in the report

v1TableRowData.description:
TableRowData represents a single row of data in a report.
Contains values for each field defined in the table structure.

int64.title: Integer value for whole number fields

v1Value.description:
Value represents a typed data value used in reports.
Supports multiple data types through a oneof field.
